method: Dated snapshot of published rates, collected by hand from bank and Ministry of Finance announcements and press rate tables. Rates are listed (挂牌) rates for new deposits; banks change them without notice. Promotional rates are marked.

deposit_insurance.rule: Deposit Insurance Regulations (存款保险条例, State Council Order No. 660, 2015): principal and interest up to 500,000 yuan per depositor per bank are fully covered.
deposit_insurance.rule_zh: 《存款保险条例》：同一存款人在同一家银行的存款本息合计50万元以内全额赔付。

deposit.rule: A fixed deposit can be withdrawn early, but the whole amount then earns only the demand-deposit rate.
deposit.rule_zh: 定期存款可以提前支取，但提前支取部分只按活期利率计息。

savings_bond.rule: Held under 6 months: no interest. 6 to 24 months: coupon minus 180 days of interest. 24 to 36 months: minus 90 days. 36 to 60 months: minus 60 days. A 0.1% fee on the redeemed principal.
savings_bond.rule_zh: 持有不满6个月不计息；满6个月不满24个月扣除180天利息；满24个月不满36个月扣除90天利息；满36个月不满60个月扣除60天利息；按提前兑取本金收取0.1%手续费。
